scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:diff: pnpm exec prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma --script
scripts.start:render: pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && pnpm --filter @vendefacil/web exec next start -H 0.0.0.0 -p ${PORT:-3000}
